text:
alex: Heads up — terraform plan in staging is hanging on 'Refreshing state...' after we rotated AWS creds in CI. Anyone else seeing this?

devops-bot: terraform-lock: lock present in dynamodb table 'tf-state-locks' for workspace 'staging' (run: run-2026-03-18-0942). No active apply detected in CI but lock timestamp is 18m old.

maria: Which job/run id? can you paste the tail of the plan log? also check if the CI session token rotated properly. :thinking:

alex: Log excerpt: ```
Refreshing state...
data.aws_iam_policy_document.ingress: Refreshing state...
aws_s3_bucket.assets: Refreshing state...
Waiting for remote state lock
```
CI link: https://ci.company/internal/runs/run-2026-03-18-0942 (permissions limited)

sam: Quick checks: `aws sts get-caller-identity` from the runner, and `terraform init -reconfigure` to make sure the backend creds are fresh. Sometimes the assume-role OIDC token expires and the refresh loop stalls.

jenna: We've seen this after key rotation — a few data sources hammer STS/API and the backend lock lingers while refresh retries. If you need to unblock, you can run `terraform plan -refresh=false` to let you inspect diffs without waiting on full refresh, but be careful — that could hide drift.

maria: If the lock is actually orphaned, you can `terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>` from a machine with backend access. Get the lock id from the dynamodb row (primary key = LockID). Only force-unlock if you're sure no apply is running.

alex: CI logs show: `AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ci-runner is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole` — looks like the role mapping changed when we rotated keys.

sam: that matches. quick remediation: 1) confirm OIDC role trust and policies, 2) re-run `aws sts get-caller-identity` in CI, 3) try `terraform init -reconfigure` and a `plan -refresh=false` to see immediate plan. If plan looks sane, coordinate a controlled apply.

jenna: Another option if refresh is expensive: run a targeted refresh on a small set of resources to surface blocking errors: `terraform refresh -target=module.db` then re-run plan. Less noisy than full refresh.

maria: I'll stand by for approval to force-unlock if alex can't fix creds quickly. If we do the unlock, let's add a quick note to the workspace run and then re-run the plan right away.

alex: I'll try the init reconfigure and update in ~10m. If it's still stuck I'll ask you to force-unlock, @maria. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: reminder: please include run id and workspace name when you escalate to eng-oncall.
